mapper.select: SELECT aorg.AGREEMENT_ID FROM scc_sou_jc_agreement_org aorg LEFT JOIN scc_sou_jc_agreement ja ON aorg.AGREEMENT_ID = ja.AGREEMENT_ID WHERE aorg.BUY_ORG_ID = #{ja.buyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ja.AGREEMENT_TYPE = #{ja.agreementType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION SELECT ain.AGREEMENT_ID FROM scc_sou_jc_agreement_info ain LEFT JOIN scc_sou_jc_agreement ja ON ain.AGREEMENT_ID = ja.AGREEMENT_ID WHERE ain.MATERIAL_CODE = #{ja.materialCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ja.AGREEMENT_TYPE = #{ja.agreementType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT ai.AGREEMENT_INFO_ID, ai.AGREEMENT_ID, ai.MATERIAL_LINE, ai.MATERIAL_ID, ai.MATERIAL_CODE, ai.MATERIAL_NAME, ai.GOODS_TYPE_ID, ai.GOODS_TYPE_CODE, ai.GOODS_TYPE_NAME, ai.STANDARDS, ai.BRAND, ai.PRICE_TAX, ai.TAX_RATE, ai.RATE_PRICE, ai.REFERENCE_PRICE, ai.LEAD_TIME, ai.SELL_BY_DATE, ai.START_NUM, ai.MULTIPLE_START_NUM, ai.AGREEMENT_DES, ai.IS_TIERED_PRICING, ai.EXPECT_NUM, ai.UNIT, ssja.AGREEMENT_ID, ssja.AGREEMENT_CODE, ssja.COMPANY_ID, ssja.COMPANY_CODE, ssja.COMPANY_NAME, ssja.AGREEMENT_NAME, ssja.SUPPLY_AREA, ssja.PAYMENT, ssja.SUP_ID, ssja.SUP_CODE, ssja.SUP_NAME, ssja.TRADING, ssja.BUY_PERSON_ID, ssja.BUY_PERSON_CODE, ssja.BUY_PERSON_NAME, ssja.PRICING_WAY, ssja.INVOICE_TYPE, ssja.PAY_WAY, ssja.AGREEMENT_STATUS, ssja.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, ssja.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, ssja.CURRENCY_TYPE, ssja.AGREEMENT_FILE_ID, ssja.AGREEMENT_FILE_NAME, ssja.AGREEMENT_TYPE, ssja.MIX_AMOUNT, ssja.REMARK, ssja.CHANGE_VERSION FROM scc_sou_jc_agreement_info ai LEFT JOIN scc_sou_jc_agreement ssja ON ai.AGREEMENT_ID = ssja.AGREEMENT_ID
AND ai.CATALOG_ON_SHELVES_ID is null
AND ssja.AGREEMENT_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{ja.agreementCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND ssja.SUP_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{ja.supCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND ssja.SUP_NAME like CONCAT('%', #{ja.supName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND ai.MATERIAL_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{ja.materialCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND ai.MATERIAL_NAME like CONCAT('%', #{ja.materialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
SELECT MAX(MATERIAL_LINE) FROM scc_sou_jc_agreement_info WHERE AGREEMENT_ID = #{agreementId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT distinct a.material_id, a.MATERIAL_CODE, a.MATERIAL_NAME FROM scc_sou_jc_agreement_info a inner join scc_sou_jc_agreement b ON a.AGREEMENT_ID = b.AGREEMENT_ID where b.SUP_CODE = 'JD001' and b.AGREEMENT_STATUS in ('EXECUTE', 'EXECUTING')
